topic: Taking old winter clothes to a donation box
passage: Last Saturday morning, I packed up a bag of old winter clothes. I had gone through my closet the night before and pulled out coats I no longer used. My wife helped me sort out the shirts and folded them into two piles. We set aside a warm jacket for my parents and put the rest into a big bag. After breakfast, I picked up the bag and walked to the community donation box. It stood near the gate, and a volunteer waited beside it. I put down the bag and filled out a short form with my name. Then I handed over the clothes and checked the list twice. The volunteer looked over each item and pointed out a shirt with a small hole. I took it back and dropped off the others. She thanked me and wrote down the number of coats. On the way home, I thought about the people who would try on those warm clothes this winter. I ended up feeling lighter, and I promised to give away unused things more often. When I got back, I hung up the leftover jacket and cleaned up the closet floor.

coach_rationale: 今早直查了 drill_sessions：有分听写仍是 7 次，最近一次仍是 10-22，样本未增加。EnglishPod365 仍无带 error_types 的新记录；今日未连 Mac 读笔记，按日志错题模式出题，弱项还是短语动词连读和过去式听辨，所以今天继续把这两类靶子埋进短文。这篇「把旧冬衣送到捐赠箱」是全新的环境话题，短文里有 packed/helped/folded/picked/walked/waited/filled/handed/checked/looked/pointed/dropped/thanked/ended/promised/cleaned/used 等规则过去式；packed up、gone through、pulled out、sort out、set aside、picked up、put down、filled out、handed over、looked over、pointed out、dropped off、wrote down、try on、ended up、give away、hung up、cleaned up、got back 是今天的短语动词连读靶子。难度保持听写 B1、跟读 A2。
